dct_description_sm: The “Land Cover for Agricultural Regions of Canada (circa 2000), Date Index” dataset is a geospatial data layer containing polygon features representing the Landsat scene number, associated dates and other products that were incorporated into the thematic land cover classification which is contained within the AAFC Landcover (circa 2000) product.
dct_title_s: Land Cover for Agricultural Regions of Canada, circa 2000, Date Index
